Here is a summary of the teaching demonstration transcript and OCR text in exactly 3 concise sentences:

The presenter, Marina Denilevsky, discusses her work on Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to improve the accuracy and up-to-dateness of large language models. She highlights two common problems with LLMs: providing un sourced answers and being out-of-date, using an anecdote about answering a question about the planet with the most moons as an example. By incorporating retrieval augmented generation, which adds a content store to rely on for answers, Marina aims to mitigate these issues and provide more reliable and accurate responses.
